title: Attend Massage
description: Resting patients, size-based finite tap/hold/drag massage, spa atmosphere and care completion lock.

presentation.progressBar.enabled.label: Quiet massage progress bar
presentation.progressBar.enabled.description: Top-centered rounded bar, with no numbers or label. Fills after complete motions, not individual taps or hold ticks.

game.holdOuterRingMultiplier.label: Hold countdown outer-ring radius
game.holdOuterRingMultiplier.description: Relative to the hold center radius. Larger values separate the countdown from the touch point; the complete ring grows on press.

game.color.label: Massage marker RGBA
game.color.description: Four values 0 to 1. Soft coral with partial transparency; white outlines preserve contrast.

presentation.smallPokemonReferenceSize.label: Small patient framing reference size
presentation.smallPokemonReferenceSize.description: Indoor posed longest dimension below this world-space size brings the camera proportionally closer. Zero disables. Long patients and outdoor giants retain their framing.

presentation.smallPokemonMinimumCameraSc.label: Smallest patient camera scale
presentation.smallPokemonMinimumCameraSc.description: Minimum additional distance and height multiplier for tiny indoor patients. 0.3 allows a camera about 3.3 times closer; 1 disables extra zoom. Pokemon and bed scale are unchanged.

presentation.cameraDistanceMultiplier.label: Camera closeness multiplier
presentation.cameraDistanceMultiplier.description: 0.8 brings the indoor camera 20% closer, retaining its angle. Outdoors scales the gap from the body, not the body bounds.

presentation.entryFadeSeconds.label: Entrance white reveal duration
presentation.entryFadeSeconds.description: The camera rises from below patient support while this white cover clears. Does not alter exit, debug reload or pose-switch timing.

presentation.lighting.tint.label: Warm light RGB tint
presentation.lighting.tint.description: Three values from 0 to 1. Indoor massage only; outdoor map lighting is preserved.

outdoorCameraYawDegrees.label: Outdoor patient viewing angle
outdoorCameraYawDegrees.description: 90 views the patient's side instead of backing into the map boundary behind a very long body.

outdoorCameraSurfaceDistance.label: Outdoor camera gap from body bounds
outdoorCameraSurfaceDistance.description: Distance beyond the visible body bounds. Keeps the camera close enough to avoid background foliage; Up/Down pans along long patients.

outdoorPokemon.label: Giant patients: keep current outdoor map
outdoorPokemon.description: Massage uses the current Attend map and world origin instead of importing the indoor room. Bed eligibility remains separately authored in the species recipe. Reviewed group: Celesteela, Guzzlord, Wailord, Kyogre, Groudon and Stakataka.

poseModeLabels.label: Pose mode labels (fixed order)
poseModeLabels.description: Default recipes, Sleep, Idle, Prone, Snake Stretch, Faint Last. Selection survives Pokemon switches and JSON reload. With D open, 6 resets to the current species default; 7 cycles comparisons. Unaligned raw bind is removed; Snake Stretch retains the reviewed long-body recipe.

restProfiles.label: Resting recipes and species assignments
restProfiles.description: Reviewed species lists select faint, sleep, prone, idle or stretched recipes. holdLastFrame holds only a resolved faint clip's final key. hiddenMeshSubstrings removes massage-only accessory/effect meshes by mesh-node name, never shared assets. hiddenJointSubstrings removes embedded accessory triangles predominantly weighted to named bone chains, preserving unrelated body geometry. jointTargets entries have node, direct child, source-world direction [x,y,z], strength (0-1), maximumDegrees (0-150); they run once in order before bed alignment. allowOverhang uses finite mattress boxes, allowing off-edge wings to hang down while the body rests lower. maximumBedWidth limits world-space torso width (0 disables).

cameraStartFraction.label: Initial view offset from body center
cameraStartFraction.description: Fraction of body length; zero uses the central body geometry, not the tail end.

bodyContactFraction.label: Body resting contact (0 uses lowest tip)

hardMattress.label: Hard mattress surface
hardMattress.description: Lift the complete visible pose above mattressHeight plus bedClearance without compression. Disables the softer bodyContactFraction placement; also enforces a final lift after skeletal fitting.
